outer_1: Address water leaks, flooded units and common areas with a coordinated response.
outer_2: Contain damage with water extraction and structural drying.
outer_3: Coordinate work around residents and building operations.
outer_4: Plan repairs and help manage unexpected expenses.

inside_left_heading: WATER MITIGATION FIRST. FULL RESTORATION WHEN NEEDED.
inside_left_body_1: Leaks, flooded units and water in common areas can disrupt residents and daily operations. For commercial, industrial, senior living and multifamily teams, the first steps are to contain damage, remove water and begin structural drying. Confirm which spaces are affected and plan access for the response team.
inside_left_subhead_2: A Practical Plan for Your Team
inside_left_body_2: A property-specific ERP gives staff a response plan, key contacts and site information before a loss. It helps organize after-hours coordination, mitigation and the transition to repairs, with resident needs and building operations in view. Review staff roles before a loss occurs.
inside_middle_heading: FROM WATER MITIGATION TO FULL RESTORATION
inside_middle_intro: For property and facility management teams:
inside_middle_1: Build a property-specific ERP with response contacts, access details and site information. Give staff a clear process for reporting a loss, sharing the details needed for response and coordinating initial mitigation work.
inside_middle_2: Coordinate water extraction and drying in affected units and common areas.
inside_middle_3: Identify the mitigation scope for affected building systems and spaces.
inside_middle_4: Coordinate access and work areas to limit disruption to residents and operations.
inside_middle_5: Track next steps, responsibilities and job information in one coordinated response.
inside_middle_6: Keep staff informed about mitigation progress, drying work, affected areas and the next steps as the job moves into repairs.
inside_middle_7: Coordinate with property teams and other involved parties so work can move from mitigation into restoration.
inside_middle_8: Support business continuity and resident needs during mitigation and repairs.
inside_middle_9: Plan restoration after the immediate water loss is contained. Coordinate repairs and return-to-service priorities with your team, while keeping the scope of work and unexpected expenses in view.
inside_right_body_1: Water extraction, structural drying and dehumidification help contain a water loss. Coordinate the work around access, affected spaces and daily building needs.
inside_right_body_2: A property-specific ERP gives staff a practical starting point for leaks and after-hours emergencies. Keep response contacts, property information and access details organized. Use the plan to coordinate mitigation, share updates and prepare for the next stage of restoration.
inside_right_body_3: Water mitigation is often the first step. When repairs are needed, GCPRO helps coordinate restoration of affected spaces and the return to service. Support also includes fire, smoke and odor restoration, storm cleanup and mold remediation.
